response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT ci.country AS country, AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_w FROM constructorStandings cs JOIN races r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId JOIN circuits ci ON ci.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY ci.country), o AS (SELECT AVG(cs.wins) AS a FROM constructorStandings cs JOIN races r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId JOIN circuits ci ON ci.circuitId = r.circuitId), g AS (SELECT c.country, c.avg_w FROM c, o WHERE c.avg_w > o.a), ga AS (SELECT AVG(avg_w) AS a FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.avg_w) AS mean_avg_wins, AVG(g.avg_w - o.a) AS mean_excess_over_overall, AVG(g.avg_w - ga.a) AS mean_excess_over_group FROM g, o, ga WHERE g.avg_w > ga.a
